title: Bound QQ16 inventory control under a sequential-handle contract
body:
This adds a conditional, executable sequential-handle model for #4790's still-unpriced inventory control. It preserves the actual caller and every original guard, encodes its current object graphs, and charges visited-flag lookup, cached membership, external ordering and cache substitution with complete word scans. Initialization, input-word copies and cleanup are included; Python pointers/hash lookups are not assigned unit physical cost.

For `Q=64K`, `w=bit_length(Q)`, each word access costs `A=Q(12w+3)+3w+1` bit instructions. The conservative kernel bound is `U(K)=1024K·A+4096K(16w+16)`. With the inherited complete census `C=511014Γ`, `S=336Γ`, source-bound sites give `1+2C` validations, `C+S` cache exchanges and `C+1` additional fixed binding budgets, hence `B=(4C+S+2)U(K)`.

The resulting sufficient comparison with frozen D is **`F+B < C(11v+4)`**. **F remains unpriced** for the compilation/frontend/source-encoding embedding and any remaining positive control outside this kernel contract. A uniform production K and physical embedding are not established. This is not a D* versus B* win, production replay, supplier admission or κ improvement; #4167/#4790 retain credit for the return saving.

The actual unchanged two-generation caller executes 24 child returns and produces the identical complete typed receipt. The observer distinguishes **49 algorithmic validations from one test-only final audit**, and sees 36 cache exchanges. The same service graph grows from 5033 to 5054 edges while its Tape count remains constant, rejecting a constructor-only graph census. Every observed snapshot satisfies the explicit reduced cap `K=65536`; this does not extrapolate that cap to production.

Validation:

- Registered normal/optimized checks pass, including 156 independent bit read/write expansions and 12 field/cap/width/alias/census controls. A review fix makes every expanded copy access `tape[head]` and immediately move one cell; XOR/OR comparisons and padded increments are explicit.
- All 144 live inputs authenticate; original source checks and the exact historical selected-record projection remain enabled.
- Exact committed-byte/source-history preflight, official 154-file export checks and final-head Git-free normal/optimized cold replay pass. Exported files remain unchanged. Source-integrity and typed-receipt corruption controls also reject.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4744#discussioncomment-19138319). Three commits separate the kernel/proof, actual-caller verification, and independent bit-checker review correction. Prior ownership/portability contributions #4949/#4956 and the complete predecessor lineage are credited. Hosted CI has not been verified. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Final submission checkpoint: official main refreshed at 05:13 UTC remains `b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15`; guidance and affected source inputs are unchanged. Fresh overlap covers 323 open PRs (05:14:01 UTC), 4,077 discussion records (05:14:50 UTC), and all 6,636 current-base notes. The scoped final query identifies the credited distinct predecessor obligations and this round's claims, not an exhaustive novelty certificate. Root and a separate interface reviewer checked the corrected literal-head access implementation, full source-site census and conditional encoding/cost boundary, with no blocker.
